20261121-physics-m3-1.goal: Apply principles of Roller coaster kanthi massa 2 kg to solve the reasoning problem.
20261121-physics-m3-1.material: Roller coaster kanthi massa 2 kg miwiti saka kahanan meneng ing titik dhuwur 20 m saka lemah ing trek tanpa gesekan. Pira energi kinetik nalika tekan lemah? (Ketentuan: g = 9,8 m/s²)
20261121-physics-m3-1.s.s1.prompt: Roller coaster kanthi massa 2 kg miwiti saka kahanan meneng ing titik dhuwur 20 m saka lemah ing trek tanpa gesekan. Pira energi kinetik nalika tekan lemah? (Ketentuan: g = 9,8 m/s²)

20261122-physics-h1-1.title: Benda massa 1 kg ditembakake kanthi
20261122-physics-h1-1.goal: Apply principles of Benda massa 1 kg ditembakake kanthi to solve the reasoning problem.
20261122-physics-h1-1.material: [Mekanika lanjutan] Benda massa 1 kg ditembakake kanthi kacepetan 20 m/s arah horizontal saka pucuk jurang kanthi dhuwur 80 m. Pira jarak horizontal sing dilewati benda iki nganti tekan lemah? (Ketentuan: g = 10 m/s², hambatan hawa diabaikan)
20261122-physics-h1-1.s.s1.prompt: [Mekanika lanjutan] Benda massa 1 kg ditembakake kanthi kacepetan 20 m/s arah horizontal saka pucuk jurang kanthi dhuwur 80 m. Pira jarak horizontal sing dilewati benda iki nganti tekan lemah? (Ketentuan: g = 10 m/s², hambatan hawa diabaikan)
20261122-physics-h1-1.s.s1.explain: Wektu tiba vertikal yaiku $80 = \frac{1}{2} \times 10 \times t^2 \implies t^2 = 16 \implies t = 4$ detik. Amarga horizontal iku gerak lurus beraturan, jarak horizontal $x = v_x t = 20\text{ m/s} \times 4\text{ s} = 80\text{ m}$.
20261122-physics-h1-1.s.s1.hint.0: Ngetung dhisik wektu tiba t: h = (1/2) g t² → 80 = (1/2) × 10 × t²
20261122-physics-h1-1.s.s1.hint.1: Etungen jarak horizontal x = v_x × t.

20261122-physics-h1-2.title: Apa alasan ilmiah OLED (dioda pemancar
20261122-physics-h1-2.goal: Apply principles of Apa alasan ilmiah OLED (dioda pemancar to solve the reasoning problem.
20261122-physics-h1-2.material: Apa alasan ilmiah OLED (dioda pemancar cahya organik) sing dienggo ing smartphone lan layar TV paling anyar luwih tipis lan nduweni kontras luwih apik tinimbang LCD biyasa?
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.prompt: Apa alasan ilmiah OLED (dioda pemancar cahya organik) sing dienggo ing smartphone lan layar TV paling anyar luwih tipis lan nduweni kontras luwih apik tinimbang LCD biyasa?
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.explain: OLED nggunakake film tipis semikonduktor organik sing mancarake cahya dhewe nalika dialiri arus, mula ora butuh unit backlight sing kandel, lan kanthi mateni piksel bisa nampilake ireng sampurna, saengga nduweni kontras tanpa wates.
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.hint.0: LCD mesthi butuh backlight sing nyorotake cahya saka mburi.
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.hint.1: Ing OLED, saben piksel mancarake cahya dhewe (Self-emissive).
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.o.o0: Amarga nggunakake piranti senyawa organik sing mancarake cahya dhewe tanpa backlight sing kapisah
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.o.o1: Amarga OLED iku cairan sing ora nggunakake listrik babar pisan
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.o.o2: Amarga ing njero OLED ana puluhan ewu lampu neon cilik
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.o.o3: Amarga nggunakake pelat wesi tinimbang substrat kaca
